d:
IAS aphsar kyon nahin hote barkhast?
Telangana haeekort ne ranga reddi jile ke kalektar si. narayan reddi ko adalat ki avmanna (Contempt of Court) ke mamle men 6 mahine ki jel aur ₹2,000 jurmane ki saza sunaee hai. yah pura vivad turkayamjal ki ek vivadit zamin ko pratibandhit suchi se hatane aur kort ke aadeshon ka samay par palan na karne se jura hai. lal batti ke is episod men janie ki aakhir 2024 se shuru huaa yah kes yahan tak kaise pahuncha, pramoti IAS adhikari narayan reddi kaun hain, aur kya is saza ke bad unki IAS ki naukri ja sakti hai ya unhen apil men rahat milegi.
